items.title: The Best Way to Use Icons in Web UIs

items.title: I Guess I’m Using WebP Now
items.blurb: After using the same few image formats for 20+ years, I’m now on the WebP bandwagon. That isn’t something I thought I’d ever say. Now I’m wondering how soon it’ll be before I can use a couple more.
